-- | Shared fixture consumers for public quoted-printable value and stream APIs.
module Main where
  import Text.QuotedPrintable
  import Effect.QuotedPrintable
  import Effect.Stream
  import Data.Bytes
  import Data.Bool
  import Data.List
  import Data.Machine
  import Data.Nat
  import Data.Option
  import Data.Result
  import Data.String

  -- | Compare byte contents without relying on a global mutable-buffer Eq instance.
  same :: Bytes -> Bytes -> Bool
  same a b = eq-i64 (bytes-compare a b) 0

  -- | Preserve decoded prefix bytes and normalize only the named physical-line-capacity error.
  codec-message :: Option QuotedPrintableError -> String
  codec-message error = case error of
    None -> ""
    Some failure -> case failure of
      QuotedPrintableLineTooLong offset -> "bufio: buffer full"
      _ -> quoted-printable-error-message failure

  -- | Check both newline policies and the independent partial decoder result.
  value-is :: Bytes -> Bytes -> Bytes -> Bytes -> String -> Bool
  value-is input text binary decoded message =
    same (quoted-printable-encode-bytes QuotedPrintableText input) text &&
    same (quoted-printable-encode-bytes QuotedPrintableBinary input) binary &&
    (case quoted-printable-decode-prefix input of
      (out, error) -> same out decoded && codec-message error == message)

  -- | Copy a checked fixture interval into independent source or expected storage.
  part :: Bytes -> Nat -> Nat -> Bytes
  part input at count = if at + count <= bytes-len input then
    let out = bytes-new count in let copied = bytes-copy-range out input 0 at count in out
    else bytes-new 0

  -- | Construct a bounded chunk source with a distinct failure after an exact input prefix.
  chunk-source :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Bytes -> Nat -> I64 -> ByteReader r
  chunk-source input chunk failure = chunk-reader (part input 0 (bytes-len input)) 0 chunk failure

  -- | Preserve source position explicitly across each custom chunk and injected failure.
  chunk-reader :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Bytes -> Nat -> Nat -> I64 -> ByteReader r
  chunk-reader input pos chunk failure = stream-reader (\request ->
    if failure >= 0 then
      let limit = nat-from-i64 failure in
      if pos >= limit then (Err (StreamClosed "fixture source failure"), chunk-reader input pos chunk failure)
      else chunk-read input pos chunk failure request (limit - pos)
    else chunk-read input pos chunk failure request request)

  -- | Return only a proved source interval, respecting request, source chunk and failure boundary.
  chunk-read :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Bytes -> Nat -> Nat -> I64 -> Nat -> Nat ->{IO r} (Result StreamError Bytes, ByteReader r)
  chunk-read input pos chunk failure request allowed =
    if pos < bytes-len input then
      let remaining = bytes-len input - pos in
      let a = if request < chunk then request else chunk in
      let b = if a < allowed then a else allowed in
      let count = if b < remaining then b else remaining in
      (Ok (part input pos count), chunk-reader input (pos + count) chunk failure)
    else (Ok (bytes-new 0), chunk-reader input pos chunk failure)

  -- | Normalize stream diagnostics to the independent fixture vocabulary.
  stream-message :: StreamError -> String
  stream-message error = case error of
    StreamClosed message -> message
    StreamEncodingError encoding offset message -> if message == "quoted-printable physical line buffer is full" then "bufio: buffer full" else message
    _ -> "unexpected stream failure"

  -- | Preserve a simultaneous read prefix and its ready/EOF/failure diagnostic.
  status-message :: QuotedPrintableReadStatus -> String
  status-message status = case status of
    QuotedPrintableReady -> ""
    QuotedPrintableEof -> "EOF"
    QuotedPrintableReadFailure error -> stream-message error

  -- | Inspect the exact source read-ahead through its advanced tee mirror.
  source-count :: forall r. QuotedPrintableReader r -> Nat
  source-count reader = case reader-tee-writer (quoted-printable-reader-source reader) of
    None -> 999999999
    Some sink -> case writer-bytes sink of
      None -> 999999999
      Some bytes -> bytes-len bytes

  -- | Validate every independent read result, including zero requests and repeated failures.
  read-steps :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => QuotedPrintableReader r -> List (Nat, (Bytes, (String, Nat))) ->{IO r} Bool
  read-steps reader steps = case steps of
    Nil -> True
    Cons step rest -> case step of
      (request, expectedPair) -> case expectedPair of
        (expected, statusPair) -> case statusPair of
          (message, consumed) -> case quoted-printable-read reader request of
            (pair, next) -> case pair of
              (out, status) -> if same out expected && status-message status == message && source-count next == consumed then read-steps next rest else False

  -- | Start one independently chunked source and retain exact source consumption observations.
  reader-is :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Bytes -> Nat -> I64 -> List (Nat, (Bytes, (String, Nat))) ->{IO r} Bool
  reader-is input chunk failure steps =
    read-steps (quoted-printable-reader (reader-tee (chunk-source input chunk failure) writer-buffer)) steps

  -- | Reset one serialized external sink fixture; a negative budget accepts all output.
  foreign import ccall "qp_fixture_reset" raw-reset :: forall r. I64 ->{IO r} I64
  -- | Copy one borrowed input span into the independent external sink fixture.
  foreign import ccall "qp_fixture_write" raw-write :: forall r. I64 -> I64 ->{IO r} I64
  -- | Observe the exact accepted external output length after success or failure.
  foreign import ccall "qp_fixture_length" raw-length :: forall r. I64 ->{IO r} I64
  -- | Observe one accepted external byte; consumers check the complete length first.
  foreign import ccall "qp_fixture_byte" raw-byte :: forall r. I64 ->{IO r} U8
  -- | Execute the independent scalar oracle against the actual linked SIMD kernel object.
  foreign import ccall "qp_fixture_kernel_check" raw-kernel-check :: forall r. I64 ->{IO r} I32

  -- | Retain the input owner until a borrowed external sink write has completed.
  hold-result :: Bytes -> I64 -> I64
  hold-result input result = case bytes-len input of _ -> result

  -- | A descriptor-like fixture sink that accepts short prefixes and then reports a stable error.
  fixture-sink :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => ByteWriter r
  fixture-sink = stream-writer (\input ->
    let accepted = hold-result input (raw-write (bytes-data input) (nat-to-i64 (bytes-len input))) in
    if accepted >= 0 then (Ok (nat-from-i64 accepted), fixture-sink)
    else (Err (StreamClosed "fixture sink failure"), fixture-sink))

  -- | Compare only initialized external sink bytes against the independent expected prefix.
  sink-bytes :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Bytes -> Nat ->{IO r} Bool
  sink-bytes expected at = if at < bytes-len expected then
    u8-to-nat (raw-byte (nat-to-i64 at)) == bytes-get expected at && sink-bytes expected (at + 1)
    else True

  -- | Check external progress before examining its exact byte prefix.
  sink-is :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Bytes ->{IO r} Bool
  sink-is expected = eq-i64 (raw-length 0) (nat-to-i64 (bytes-len expected)) && sink-bytes expected 0

  -- | Normalize success or a failure checkpoint without discarding the reported input prefix.
  write-result-is :: Result (Nat, StreamError) Nat -> Nat -> String -> Bool
  write-result-is result expected message = case result of
    Ok count -> count == expected && message == ""
    Err pair -> case pair of (count, error) -> count == expected && stream-message error == message

  -- | Finish only an independently successful trace, leaving failed traces at their accepted prefix.
  finish-write :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => QuotedPrintableWriter r -> Bool -> String -> Bytes ->{IO r} Bool
  finish-write writer finish closeMessage expectedFinal =
    if finish then
      case quoted-printable-finish writer of
        (result, sink) ->
          let message = case result of Ok unit -> ""; Err error -> stream-message error in
          message == closeMessage && sink-is expectedFinal
    else sink-is expectedFinal

  -- | Validate each write's mode update, accepted input count, failure and observable output prefix.
  write-steps :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => QuotedPrintableWriter r -> List (Bytes, (Bool, (Nat, (String, Bytes)))) -> Bool -> String -> Bytes ->{IO r} Bool
  write-steps writer steps finish closeMessage expectedFinal = case steps of
    Nil -> finish-write writer finish closeMessage expectedFinal
    Cons step rest -> case step of
      (input, modePair) -> case modePair of
        (binary, countPair) -> case countPair of
          (accepted, messagePair) -> case messagePair of
            (message, expected) ->
              let mode = if binary then QuotedPrintableBinary else QuotedPrintableText in
              case quoted-printable-write (quoted-printable-writer-mode mode writer) input of
                (result, next) ->
                  if write-result-is result accepted message && sink-is expected then write-steps next rest finish closeMessage expectedFinal else False

  -- | Start a compliant failing sink and validate the complete independent writer trace.
  writer-is :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => I64 -> List (Bytes, (Bool, (Nat, (String, Bytes)))) -> Bool -> String -> Bytes ->{IO r} Bool
  writer-is limit steps finish closeMessage expected =
    let reset = raw-reset limit in
    write-steps (quoted-printable-writer QuotedPrintableText fixture-sink) steps finish closeMessage expected

  -- | Input mutation and repeated feeds cannot change an encoder's retained prefix.
  encoder-ownership :: Unit -> Bool
  encoder-ownership unit =
    let input = string-to-bytes "abc" in
    case quoted-printable-encoder-feed (quoted-printable-encoder QuotedPrintableText) input of
      (empty, state) ->
        let changed = if bytes-len input > 0 then bytes-set input 0 88 else () in
        case quoted-printable-encoder-feed state (string-to-bytes "d\n") of
          (first, final) ->
            let correct = same first (string-to-bytes "abcd\r\n") in
            let mutated = if bytes-len first > 0 then bytes-set first 0 89 else () in
            bytes-len empty == 0 && correct && same (quoted-printable-encoder-finish state) (string-to-bytes "abc") &&
              (case quoted-printable-encoder-feed state (string-to-bytes "e") of
                (other, fork) -> same (quoted-printable-encoder-finish fork) (string-to-bytes "abce") && bytes-len (quoted-printable-encoder-finish final) == 0)

  -- | Decoder inputs, emitted chunks and forked continuations have independent storage.
  decoder-ownership :: Unit -> Bool
  decoder-ownership unit =
    let input = string-to-bytes "ab=3" in
    case quoted-printable-decoder-feed quoted-printable-decoder input of
      (empty, pair) -> case pair of
        (count, state) ->
          let changed = if bytes-len input > 0 then bytes-set input 0 88 else () in
          case quoted-printable-decoder-feed state (string-to-bytes "Dcd\n") of
            (first, nextPair) ->
              let correct = same first (string-to-bytes "ab=cd\n") in
              let mutated = if bytes-len first > 0 then bytes-set first 0 89 else () in
              count == 4 && bytes-len empty == 0 && correct &&
                (case quoted-printable-decoder-feed state (string-to-bytes "0ef\n") of
                  (fork, finalPair) -> same fork (string-to-bytes "ab0ef\n")) &&
                (case quoted-printable-decoder-finish state of
                  (tail, error) -> same tail (string-to-bytes "ab=3") && codec-message error == "")

  -- | Mutating returned read prefixes cannot affect privately retained decoded surplus.
  reader-ownership :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Unit ->{IO r} Bool
  reader-ownership unit =
    let input = string-to-bytes "abcdef\n" in
    case quoted-printable-read (quoted-printable-reader (reader-from-bytes input)) 2 of
      (pair, next) -> case pair of
        (out, status) ->
          let correct = same out (string-to-bytes "ab") && status-message status == "" in
          let changed-input = if bytes-len input > 0 then bytes-set input 0 88 else () in
          let changed-output = if bytes-len out > 0 then bytes-set out 0 89 else () in
          case quoted-printable-read next 100 of
            (tailPair, final) -> case tailPair of
              (tail, terminal) -> correct && same tail (string-to-bytes "cdef\n") && status-message terminal == "EOF"

  -- | Additional public offsets refer to original physical input, including prior soft breaks.
  precise-errors :: Unit -> Bool
  precise-errors unit =
    (case quoted-printable-decode-prefix (string-to-bytes "ab\u{0}tail") of
      (out, Some (QuotedPrintableInvalidByte 2 0)) -> same out (string-to-bytes "ab")
      _ -> False) &&
    (case quoted-printable-decode-prefix (string-to-bytes "ab=\rX\n") of
      (out, Some (QuotedPrintableInvalidHex 3 13)) -> same out (string-to-bytes "ab")
      _ -> False) &&
    (case quoted-printable-decode-prefix (string-to-bytes "ab==\n") of
      (out, Some (QuotedPrintableIncompleteEscape 2)) -> same out (string-to-bytes "ab")
      _ -> False) &&
    (case quoted-printable-decoder-feed quoted-printable-decoder (string-to-bytes "a=\n") of
      (first, pair) -> case pair of
        (count, state) -> case quoted-printable-decoder-feed state (string-to-bytes "b\u{0}\nlater") of
          (out, nextPair) -> case nextPair of
            (consumed, next) -> count == 3 && same first (string-to-bytes "a") && consumed == 3 && same out (string-to-bytes "b") &&
              (case quoted-printable-decoder-error next of Some (QuotedPrintableInvalidByte 4 0) -> True; _ -> False))

  -- | The generic bridge drains a partial prefix once, then preserves its sticky failure across zero reads.
  bridge-progress :: forall r. using (io :: Io r) => Unit ->{IO r} Bool
  bridge-progress unit =
    let reader = quoted-printable-reader-as-stream (quoted-printable-reader (reader-from-string "ab\u{0}\n")) in
    case stream-read reader 7 of
      (Ok prefix, next) -> case stream-read next 7 of
        (Err error, failed) -> case stream-read failed 0 of
          (Ok empty, afterZero) -> case stream-read afterZero 7 of
            (Err repeated, final) -> same prefix (string-to-bytes "ab") && bytes-len empty == 0 && stream-message error == "quotedprintable: invalid unescaped byte 0x00 in body" && stream-message repeated == stream-message error
            _ -> False
          _ -> False
        _ -> False
      _ -> False

  -- | Execute independent continuation, offset, partial-error and returned-buffer mutation controls.
  main :: Unit ->{IO r} Int
  main unit = with (io = newIO ()) in
    if encoder-ownership () then if decoder-ownership () then if reader-ownership () then if precise-errors () then if bridge-progress () then 0 else 5 else 4 else 3 else 2 else 1
